scope: Authorize the frozen 18 fresh serial original/full versus Next harder Docs attempts, with three repetitions per task and arm. No performance-based early stop or historical baseline reuse. No target is claimed achieved.

findings_resolved: Read evidence requires actual returned native objects or XML nodes, including empty cells and container relationships.
Focused input has distinct operational records and plausible archived facts, with identical deterministic state across arms.
Supported original XML/native/full/scoped strategies remain valid; only edited paragraph identities are normalized.
Unrelated state is preserved through every signed mutation; target text and marks are graded in authenticated final state.
Known answer or native preservation failures remain failures alongside an unsupported request; historical classification is unchanged.

product_validation.basis: Retained owner product and native evidence checked for matching final candidate revision, binary and archive; no product or native rerun by this reviewer.

reporting_controls.coverage: Strictly above, exactly and below 50 percent; unknown/inconclusive token scores unavailable; known success regression fails even when cost unavailable.

comparison_limits: Each task independently requires strictly more than 50 percent fewer all-attempt tokens per verified success and observed success nonregression; exactly 50 percent fails.
All failures, recovery and in-loop full selected skill reads count; no pooled or matched-success score substitutes for the primary gate.
Eighteen fresh attempts cover three fixed development tasks, not statistical parity, a scaling curve or all-functionality coverage.
Source-backed synthetic table/list projections and native known-state comparisons do not establish universal rich editing or atomic compare-and-swap.
The requested provider model is a mutable alias; no new paid availability probe was made.
review_execution: Independent source review, retained-log inspection and read-only frozen hash/provenance validation. No model or live API calls, no product edits.
